mapper.select: SELECT * FROM device_info WHERE online = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND last_heartbeat_time < #{threshold}
mapper.update: UPDATE device_info SET online = 0, offline_reason = #{reason}, last_offline_time = NOW(3), update_time = NOW(3) WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND online = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND (last_heartbeat_time = #{lastHeartbeatTime} OR (last_heartbeat_time IS NULL AND #{lastHeartbeatTime} IS NULL))

UPDATE device_info SET uptime = #{uptime}, last_heartbeat_time = NOW(3), last_payload = #{payload}, online = 1, offline_reason = NULL, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE device_info SET online = 0, offline_reason = #{reason}, last_offline_time = NOW(3), update_time = NOW(3) WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND online = 1 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE device_info SET firmware = #{firmware}, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND deleted = 0 AND (firmware <> #{firmware} OR firmware IS NULL)
UPDATE device_info SET ota_state = NULL, ota_progress = NULL, ota_update_time = NOW(3), update_time = NOW(3) WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE device_info SET current_state = JSON_SET(IFNULL(current_state, '{}'), CONCAT('$."', #{key}, '"'), #{state}), update_time = NOW(3) WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND deleted = 0
